title: Linear confidence coefficient
statement: For each natural number $k$, let $T_k$ be the junta tree call count and $D_k$ the low degree junta cutoff. The linear confidence coefficient is the natural number $\lceil \log_2 T_k\rceil + 2(D_k+1)+5$, where the first term denotes the least natural number $m$ such that $T_k\le 2^m$.
